notes: Encoded ONLY from Evcon's own page. No Coleman/York system imported despite the page's sister-brand list. SHIPPED: page Styles 3 and 4 (digit systems, text-verified). HELD, NOT SHIPPED: page Style 1 (year wording '2nd-4th numerical digits combined' yields 3 digits '589' from W0K5896070, which is not a 2- or 4-digit year and cannot be encoded; month is a chart-only 3rd-character letter) and page Style 2 (month = 2nd letter, year = 3rd letter, both chart-only). Both held styles are image-pass items.

styles.notes: Page: year = 1st-2nd digits, month = 3rd-4th digits. Example decodes 99 -> 1999, 06 -> June.

Page: month = 1st-2nd digits, year = 3rd-4th digits. Example decodes 01 -> January, 88 -> 1988, consistent with the stated pre-1992 era. Pattern is disjoint from style-3 (10 vs 9 digits) and from held style-1 (letter-led).
